question.text: Himalaya Arbitrage Fund issues new Class A units of INR 200 crore in aggregate to LPs. What is the stamp duty payable on ISSUE of AIF units per Chapter 14 (effective 1 July 2020)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook stamp-duty table: Issue of AIF units = 0.005%. Duty = 200,00,00,000 × 0.005% = INR 1,00,000. Transfer of AIF units attracts a higher 0.015%. No stamp duty applies at redemption. The Trap: A applies the 0.015% TRANSFER rate. C applies a 0.1% STT-style rate. D is false — units attract stamp duty since 1 July 2020. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/XIX-B test stamp duty from the distribution/selling angle. XIX-E tests it from the issuance side — the Fund pays on behalf of LPs and may recover via entry cost. Manager's Pro-Tip: At Himalaya, automate stamp-duty accrual in the subscription pipeline — the 0.005% is tiny per ticket but mis-accruals at quarter-end reconciliation cause avoidable NAV breaks.
